name: @aise/visual-render
description: AISE bounded visual-solution provider lane (HFX-303): the provider-neutral visual-rendering PORT where image/3D-generation technologies (Apple SHARP, TRELLIS.2 and future occupants) render solution states for inspection/presentation ONLY — never engineering geometry authority. Generated visuals are presentation: they can never change quantities, validation or canonical Solution Graph state (proven by tests); every artifact carries provenance binding the exact solution/state revision plus the provider profile; provider swap changes presentation only; missing/failed generation falls back to the canonical deterministic 2D/3D views; generated details beyond deterministic geometry are labeled. Evidenced with in-repo deterministic providers (reference + alternate + failing fixture) — no external model, no network, no new dependencies.
